lines.pinyin: Wǒ měitiān zǎoshang qī diǎn qǐchuáng.
lines.english: I get up at seven every morning.

lines.hanzi: 先刷牙，洗脸，然后吃早饭。
lines.pinyin: Xiān shuāyá, xǐliǎn, ránhòu chī zǎofàn.
lines.english: First brush teeth, wash face, then eat breakfast.

lines.hanzi: 早饭通常吃面包，喝牛奶。
lines.pinyin: Zǎofàn tōngcháng chī miànbāo, hē niúnǎi.
lines.english: Breakfast is usually bread and milk.

lines.hanzi: 八点半我坐地铁去上班。
lines.pinyin: Bā diǎn bàn wǒ zuò dìtiě qù shàngbān.
lines.english: At eight thirty I take the subway to work.

lines.hanzi: 中午十二点在公司食堂吃饭。
lines.pinyin: Zhōngwǔ shíèr diǎn zài gōngsī shítáng chīfàn.
lines.english: At noon twelve I eat at the company cafeteria.

lines.hanzi: 下午五点下班，回家的路上买菜。
lines.pinyin: Xiàwǔ wǔ diǎn xiàbān, huíjiā de lùshang mǎi cài.
lines.english: At five PM I get off work, buy vegetables on the way home.

lines.hanzi: 晚上七点做晚饭，全家一起吃。
lines.pinyin: Wǎnshang qī diǎn zuò wǎnfàn, quánjiā yīqǐ chī.
lines.english: At seven PM make dinner, the whole family eats together.

lines.hanzi: 饭后我看电视，或者看书。
lines.pinyin: Fàn hòu wǒ kàn diànshì, huòzhě kàn shū.
lines.english: After dinner I watch TV or read books.
At ten thirty go to bed and sleep.

lines.hanzi: 我的一天很充实，也很快乐。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ de yī tiān hěn chōngshí, yě hěn kuàilè.
lines.english: My day is very fulfilling and also very happy.
